bias.en: Uptrend, momentum fading · back above the 30-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势，动能减弱 · 重回 30 日均线上方

read.en: Palantir rose 4.4% on Oct 19 to $194.15, rebounding from $186.15 to a high of $196.99. It is above the rising 30-day ($187.1), 100-day ($157.8) and 200-day ($152.7) averages and below the falling 5-day ($198.1) and rising 10-day ($199.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is above zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($211.41), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: Palantir 10月19日上涨 4.4%，收于 $194.15，自 $186.15 反弹至高点 $196.99。股价位于上行的 30 日（$187.1）、100 日（$157.8）和 200 日均线（$152.7）上方，位于下行的 5 日（$198.1）和上行的 10 日均线（$199.3）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$211.41），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 30-day average and the $192.6 Oct 15 low, both lost on Oct 16. Resistance is $197–199.3 (Oct 19 high, 5 and 10-day averages), then $203.6 (Oct 16 high) and $211.4–212.9 (SAR, Oct 12 record high). Support is $192.6 (Oct 15 low), then $186–187 (30-day, Oct 19 low) and $184.5 (Oct 16 low). A close above $199.3 would open $203.6.
